validated_results.title: Serum calcium and incident and fatal prostate cancer in the Swedish AMORIS study.
validated_results.reason: Prospective cohort of 196,022 Swedish men relating baseline serum (albumin-corrected) calcium to incident prostate cancer with quartile hazard ratios reported.

extraction.comparison_type: 4th quartile of albumin-corrected calcium vs 1st quartile
extraction.population: Men with baseline serum calcium and albumin measurements in the Swedish Apolipoprotein MOrtality RISk (AMORIS) study

sample_size.excerpt: A cohort based on 196,022 men with baseline information on calcium (mmol/L) and albumin (g/L) was selected from the Swedish Apolipoprotein MOrtality RISk study.

cases.excerpt: A total of 6,353 men were diagnosed with PCa and 731 died of PCa during mean follow-up of 12 years.

effect_size.excerpt: A weak negative association was found between levels of calcium or albumin-corrected calcium and PCa risk (HR for quartiles of albumin-corrected calcium: 0.95 (0.89-1.02), 0.93 (0.86-1.00), and 0.91 (0.85-0.98) for the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th quartile compared to the 1st; p for trend: 0.012).

confidence_interval.excerpt: A weak negative association was found between levels of calcium or albumin-corrected calcium and PCa risk (HR for quartiles of albumin-corrected calcium: 0.95 (0.89-1.02), 0.93 (0.86-1.00), and 0.91 (0.85-0.98) for the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th quartile compared to the 1st; p for trend: 0.012).

comparison.excerpt: for the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th quartile compared to the 1st

continent.excerpt: the Swedish Apolipoprotein MOrtality RISk study

exposure_measurement.excerpt: baseline information on calcium (mmol/L) and albumin (g/L)

validated_results.reason: Nested case-control study within the PLCO Screening Trial reporting odds ratios for serum alpha-tocopherol and gamma-tocopherol quintiles and incident prostate cancer.

extraction.comparison_type: highest vs lowest quintile of serum alpha-tocopherol
extraction.population: Men in the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial: 680 prostate cancer cases and 824 frequency-matched controls

sample_size.excerpt: We conducted a nested case-control study of serum α-tocopherol and γ-tocopherol and prostate cancer risk in the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial, with 680 prostate cancer cases and 824 frequency-matched controls.
sample_size.location: abstract, methods; total_n derived from reported group counts 680 + 824 = 1504

cases.excerpt: We conducted a nested case-control study of serum α-tocopherol and γ-tocopherol and prostate cancer risk in the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial, with 680 prostate cancer cases and 824 frequency-matched controls.

effect_size.excerpt: Higher serum α-tocopherol was associated with significantly lower prostate cancer risk (OR for the highest vs. lowest quintile = 0.63, 95% CI 0.44-0.92, p-trend 0.05).
